title: DamageDoctor Combined YOLO
subtitle: Merged CarDD + VeHIDE (subsampled) in YOLO format — 6 classes
description:
Private training dataset for the DamageDoctor project. Combines CarDD (2816 train / 810 val / 374 test) with a subsampled subset of the VeHIDE Vietnamese insurance car damage dataset (~4000 additional training images). Class distribution is balanced via per-class capping at 3000 annotations. Val and test splits are CarDD-only for a stable benchmark.

Classes: 0=dent, 1=scratch, 2=crack, 3=glass shatter, 4=lamp broken, 5=tire flat.

Rebuilt locally with `python src/convert_vehide_to_yolo.py` before upload.
